evaluation: PHYSIS v0.3.1 claim-evidence alignment deterministic controls

scope.method: Direct execution of physis.alignment.align_claim against actual bundled corpus passages plus explicitly labeled synthetic stress controls.
scope.labels: Expected relations were manually assigned from the cited source text before running this script; labels were not blinded or independently graded.
scope.independence: Control claims are authored in this script and do not import education cards, education held-out fixtures, or prior 72-turn regression outcomes.
limits: This small deterministic control set is not an estimate of open-domain semantic accuracy.
Most controls exercise curated relation patterns; unseen paraphrase coverage is bounded to the listed claims.
Synthetic controls test conflict aggregation and sign normalization, not citation authenticity.
No language model, network request, or provider inference was used.

cases.claim: The most remarkable and unexpected fact about falling objects is that, if air resistance and friction are negligible, then in a given location all objects fall toward the center of Earth with the same constant acceleration, independent of their mass.
cases.rationale: A complete verified source sentence should be directly supported.
cases.observed_reason: 주장 전체가 검증된 인용문의 한 문장과 일치합니다.

cases.claim: When drag can be ignored, objects with different masses accelerate downward at the same rate in one place.
cases.rationale: Restates mass-independent acceleration and preserves the source's drag/location conditions.
cases.observed_reason: 인용문에 관련 용어가 있지만 이 관계를 뒷받침하지는 않습니다.

cases.claim: In a vacuum, the heavier object falls with greater acceleration than the lighter one.
cases.rationale: The stated vacuum condition is compatible with negligible drag, while the acceleration relation is opposite.
cases.observed_reason: 인용문은 명시된 조건에서 가속도가 질량과 무관하다고 하지만, 주장은 반대 관계를 말합니다.

cases.claim: When air resistance is significant, objects of unequal mass still share the same falling acceleration.
cases.rationale: The source restricts its claim to negligible drag and does not settle significant-drag behavior.
cases.observed_reason: 근거는 항력이 무시 가능하고 위치가 일정한 조건에 한정되지만, 주장은 그 범위를 바꿉니다.

cases.claim: Mass changes the color of a falling body.
cases.rationale: The topic overlaps, but the source says nothing about color.
cases.observed_reason: 인용문에 관련 용어가 있지만 이 관계를 뒷받침하지는 않습니다.

cases.rationale: The verified passage provides no relevant information for this claim.
cases.observed_reason: 검증된 인용문은 이 주장을 다루지 않습니다.

cases.claim: More net force produces greater acceleration in the system.
cases.rationale: Restates the positive force/acceleration relation from the verified Newton passage.
cases.observed_reason: 계의 가속도와 알짜 외력에 관한 이 관계는 검토된 문단에 있습니다.

cases.claim: Acceleration is inversely proportional to net force.
cases.rationale: The source states direct proportionality to net external force.
cases.observed_reason: 근거는 가속도와 알짜 외력 또는 질량 사이에 이 주장과 반대되는 관계를 제시합니다.

cases.claim: Acceleration depends on net force and mass.
cases.rationale: The terms are present but the direction or form of the relation is not stated.
cases.observed_reason: 근거는 관련 있지만 힘과 가속도 사이의 주장을 판단하기 어렵습니다.

cases.claim: At small angles, a pendulum's restoring force grows in proportion to displacement.
cases.rationale: Restates the supported small-angle restoring-force relation.
cases.observed_reason: 근거는 작은 각도 조건을 제시하지만 이 주장은 뒷받침되는 복원력 관계를 밝히지 않습니다.

cases.claim: For large angles, a pendulum's restoring force is proportional to displacement.
cases.rationale: The source limits this approximation to angles below about 15 degrees.
cases.observed_reason: 인용된 관계는 작은 각도에 한정되어 제시된 큰 각도에 적용되는지 알 수 없습니다.

cases.claim: A pendulum's restoring force is proportional to the square of displacement.
cases.rationale: The source's small-angle relation is linear in displacement, not quadratic.
cases.observed_reason: 근거는 작은 각도에서 정비례 관계를 제시하며 반비례 관계를 말하지 않습니다.

cases.claim: Velocity includes a direction as well as a magnitude.
cases.rationale: Restates both defining vector attributes in the verified source.
cases.observed_reason: 속도의 크기와 방향을 함께 가진다는 설명은 검토된 문장에 있습니다.

cases.claim: Velocity is a scalar with only magnitude; direction is irrelevant.
cases.rationale: The source explicitly states that velocity has both magnitude and direction.
cases.observed_reason: 검토된 문장은 속도에 크기와 방향이 모두 있다고 설명합니다.

cases.rationale: Restates the source definition of momentum as the product of mass and velocity.
cases.observed_reason: 운동량이 질량과 속도의 곱이라는 관계는 검토된 문장에 있습니다.

cases.claim: Density is the amount of mass per unit volume.
cases.observed_reason: 밀도가 부피당 질량이라는 관계는 검토된 문장에 있습니다.

cases.claim: Average velocity is displacement divided by elapsed time.
cases.observed_reason: 평균 속도가 변위를 걸린 시간으로 나눈 값이라는 관계는 검토된 문장에 있습니다.

cases.claim: The most remarkable and unexpected fact about falling objects is that, if air resistance and friction are negligible, then in a given location all objects fall toward the center of Earth with the same constant acceleration, independent of their mass.
cases.rationale: A synthetic opposing statement is paired with the real verified passage; the conflict should prevent certification.
cases.observed_reason: 검증된 문단 사이에서 이 주장에 관한 관계가 서로 충돌합니다.

cases.rationale: The shared quantity terms make this related-only, but the plus sign must not normalize to the negative source value or earn direct support.
cases.observed_reason: 인용문에 관련 용어가 있지만 이 관계를 뒷받침하지는 않습니다.
